Completed and verified a broad maintenance pass:

- PDF pagination: added a points-to-inches helper, reduced repeated header-height reservation, and added an 86-item/two-page regression test. Invoice PDF tests passed (14 passed, 1 skipped), the billing suite passed (83 passed, 4 skipped), and `git diff --check` was clean. - Tenacity retry refactor was explicitly stopped and remains deferred; pinning httpx to 0.23 was ruled out.
- Deployment context: staging exports now use `ledgerly-exports-stg-v2`; the old `ledgerly-exports-stg` bucket is frozen and must not be written to.

Added tests for the March 09:00 transition and a midnight transition, including UTC and local-time assertions. Scheduler and billing tests passed (31 total), Ruff and whitespace checks passed. The full suite then reported 186 passed, 2 skipped, 1 unrelated failure in `tests/test_invoices.py::test_rounding_legacy_currency` (expected 1000, got 1001).
